title: We'll Be Right Back
blurb: A smash-cut escape hatch borrowed from The Eric Andre Show, where the sting arrives precisely when a situation has become unsalvageable. Nothing is resolved. Nothing is addressed. The broadcast simply ends and something else begins, a genuinely liberating structure once you notice it. Use it to edit out conversations going off the rails, moments that became incriminating, or a joke that landed somewhere nobody intended. The implied freeze-frame is doing half the work. We will not, in fact, be right back.
origin: The cutaway sting popularized by The Eric Andre Show meme edits.
